scope: Source review only; no successor execution, runtime binding or permission to use unresolved fields.

fields.productionRequirement: Determine Firewood eligibility and the resource debit after completing a standard Rest.
fields.rule: One supplied Firewood token permits one Rest; completing that Rest discards one Firewood token.

fields.productionRequirement: Bind the correct current Quest budget to each Rest session.
fields.rule: The current Quest card supplies the Resting Point amount available to the party for the Rest.

fields.productionRequirement: Keep allocation under player control with party agreement and the printed equal-split fallback.
fields.rule: Whole party agrees to Rest, then collectively allocates points; an equal split is available if distribution cannot be agreed.

fields.productionRequirement: Convert each spent point into the specified base Life or Stress recovery.
fields.rule: Each point spent recovers exactly 1 Life or exactly 1 Stress.

fields.derivation: The party chooses how much each Hero receives; the equal-split fallback and discussion of amounts support more than one point per Hero. No new per-Hero limit is introduced.
fields.productionRequirement: Determine whether more than one point can be allocated to the same Hero.
fields.rule: A Hero may receive multiple points and chooses how to spend that Hero's allocation.

fields.derivation: One Life or one Stress per point is an alternative conversion; the same point is not two recoveries.
fields.productionRequirement: Prevent the same point from being counted as both Life and Stress recovery.
fields.rule: A point recovers Life or Stress, never both.

fields.productionRequirement: Determine the budget condition required to commit a completed Rest.
fields.blockingReason: Distributing the printed amount and recovering per point spent does not explicitly require spending every point. The historical all-points forum authority is inadmissible.

fields.productionRequirement: Determine whether a partly spent positive budget may complete Rest.
fields.blockingReason: Official text supplies neither permission nor prohibition to finish after a partial spend. The historical prohibition relies on the disallowed all-points clarification.

fields.productionRequirement: Determine whether Rest with a positive printed budget can complete with no points spent.
fields.blockingReason: The historical derivation depends on a full-budget requirement that official evidence does not establish. Firewood discard after Rest does not establish zero-point completion legality.

fields.productionRequirement: Determine completion legality when the printed budget exceeds total recoverable Life/Stress.
fields.blockingReason: No standard Rest passage selects waste-without-effect, discard, partial completion, inability to Rest, or another completion rule when recovery need is lower than the printed amount.

fields.productionRequirement: Restrict standard Rest initiation to a cleared Room.
fields.rule: Rest is legal only in a cleared Room.

fields.productionRequirement: Determine legal allocations above current recovery need, not merely clamp actual recovery results.
fields.blockingReason: Official Wound removal and the Stress track bound actual recovery, but do not establish the historical rule rejecting allocations above missing Life/current Stress. C4B does not infer allocation legality from a model invariant.
